quote: First, feedback must be sufficiently local.
notes: 锚点给出反馈的第一条属性：局部性。它不是「多给指标」而是「小到能定位」

quote: Second, feedback must be inexpensive and timely to obtain.
notes: 第二条属性：便宜且及时。这一条直接决定 agent 一天能跑多少实验

quote: Third, feedback must support objective verification.
notes: 第三条属性：可客观验证。三条合起来才构成 actionable

quote: Here, "dense" does not mean feeding the agent as many logs and metrics as possible.
notes: ⚠️ 关键澄清：dense ≠ 多。它明确反对「把日志全塞给 agent」。这一点常被误读为「加大上下文」，实为相反

quote: Correctness feedback answers, "Is the computation correct?"
notes: 三层反馈各答一问：对不对 / 时间去哪了 / 哪种更好

quote: End-to-end metrics can tell an agent that results got worse, but they cannot explain why.
locator: From End-to-End Metrics / 问题陈述
notes: 这是全篇的问题定义句：端到端指标能说「变差了」，不能说「为什么」

quote: How do we turn sparse end-to-end results into fine-grained, attributable engineering feedback
locator: From End-to-End Metrics / 研究问题
notes: 研究问题原文。注意它用的是 sparse，与 dense 构成对立面

quote: we discovered a numerical accuracy issue in the KDA kernel's Context Parallelism (CP) path
notes: 案例一：CP 与非 CP 路径的数值不一致，定位到 KDA kernel。属「先建映射再比较」的正例

quote: The key point is that entering C++ does not automatically release the GIL.
notes: 案例二：KV Transfer 与计算不重叠，根因是 C++ 段持锁未释放 GIL。⚠️ 这是全篇最强的证据：它跨越 Python/C++ 语言边界

quote: the performance gap between Prefill + KV Transfer and Prefill alone fell below 1% after the fix
locator: System Behavior Feedback / 案例二结果
notes: 案例二的验收：从 >20% 降到 <1%。用的是预先设定的性能约束，不是事后挑的数字

quote: tiled along the V dimension, causing the same FP32 normalization and gating computations to be repeated four times
notes: 案例三：V 维分块导致公共计算重复四次。这是「为并行而并行」的典型代价

quote: achieved a 1.71× speedup over v2
notes: 案例三：合并分块 + 寄存器驻留 + warp 级归约，1.71x over v2

quote: reduced v1's execution time by 9.6%
locator: Performance Feedback / 案例三中间步
notes: 中间那一步只拿到 9.6%，说明增益是**逐层累积**而来，不是一次大跳

quote: a cluster of more than 100,000 Chinese-made AI accelerators
notes: 规模：>10 万张国产加速器。这是「生产级」这一限定词的依据

quote: improved end-to-end serving performance by roughly 3
notes: ⚠️ 原文是 roughly 3×，不是某些二手报道写的 3.2×。本篇一律引原文口径

quote: from initial model adaptation to production readiness in less than two weeks
notes: 两周：从初次适配到生产就绪。这是锚点唯一的「时间」类指标

quote: processing more than 62 trillion tokens in six days
notes: 62 万亿 token / 6 天：说明这套栈确实承载了真实流量，而非 benchmark 环境

quote: we have not yet reached recursive self-improvement
notes: ⚠️ 锚点自己否认已达 RSI。这一句是本篇判定「锚点属 L1–L2」的直接依据

quote: Choosing objectives, setting boundaries, and assessing risk remain human responsibilities
notes: 人类仍负责三件事：定目标、划边界、判风险。这是 L3 未达的判据

quote: Engineers defined objectives and system boundaries
notes: 分工原文：人定目标与边界、agent 做分析与改动、环境提供反馈

quote: On 100 natural-length requests, it reaches 1,942 tokens/s against 594 tokens/s for vanilla, a 3.27
notes: SEIS 核心数字：1942 vs 594 tok/s（3.27x），100 条自然长度请求

quote: Mean request latency falls from 295 to 89 ms
notes: 平均请求延迟 295→89 ms。与吞吐同向，非此消彼长。该比值 295/89≈3.31 是本篇图 4 中「延迟下降比」一柱的来源

quote: the speedup comes from redesigning the whole engine
notes: ⚠️ 关键归因：增益来自**整体重构**而非单点优化。这支持「跨层」而非「单层叠加」

quote: Most of the best engine’s natural-request speedup remains with speculation disabled
notes: 消融：关掉投机解码后大部分增益仍在，说明 kernel/runtime 改动是主因

quote: forms a two-level Recursive Self-Improvement loop—revising priors online within runs and distilling experience across clusters
notes: InfraRSI 的核心声明：run 内在线修正先验 + 跨集群经验蒸馏

quote: geometric-mean speedup, consistently outperforming open-code RE-Bench
notes: ⚠️ 四工作负载的几何平均是 1.83x，不是某些二手材料写的 2.75x。2.75x 只是 Qwen3.5-9B 单个 workload 的最佳值（表 4 内），拿单点当总体是常见的引用错误。该句原文含 LaTeX 重复渲染（'1.83 × 1.83\times'），故引其后的片段；MFU 17.4%→30.0% 是四负载均值，可对

quote: single edits often hit out-of-memory (OOM) boundaries
notes: ⚠️ 训练侧的难点是**耦合**：单点改动常触发 OOM。这与推理侧「改一处能独立验证」形成对照

quote: Experience Graph Memory
notes: KOPE 把 decision→feedback→后续决策 存成图，而非自然语言摘要

quote: pass rate from 60.0
notes: Active Context Management：pass 60.0%→84.6%

quote: from 15.9B to 1.113B tokens
notes: 同一改动把优化 token 消耗从 15.9B 降到 1.113B。⚠️ 这说明「省 token」与「提效果」可以同向，反驳了「多给上下文才有效」

quote: raises full-suite pass rate from 55.2
notes: Experience Graph 本身：全量 pass 55.2%→84.6%

quote: a central supervisor that diagnoses each local optimum and restructures a team of agents
notes: EAT 的机制：supervisor 诊断局部最优并**重组团队**。被演化的对象是组织结构，不是代码

quote: wins on 36 of 47 production workloads
notes: 36/47 个生产 workload 胜出。注意它报的是「胜率」而非单一加速比

quote: screened 786 task-source records, retaining 203 source candidates
Twenty-three of the final 53 tasks incorporated verifier revisions
notes: 23/53 个任务的验证器被修订过（≈43.4%，见本篇图 8）。验证器是**迭代出来的**，不是写一次就对

quote: the backbone already solves most episodes (92.31%)
notes: ⚠️ ALFWorld 上 backbone 已达 92.31%，故增益空间极小。这是「元级演化有天花板」的直接证据

quote: The static skill slightly regresses
notes: 静态技能在该任务上甚至**倒退**，单层演化只恢复到 No-Skill 基线

quote: algorithmic discovery
notes: AlphaEvolve 自述为 algorithmic discovery，连 agent 都不提。⚠️ 这解释了为何按 agent 类词检索不到它

quote: modifies its own code
notes: DGM 改的是自己的 coding agent 源码并选择后代，是严格 RSI 的参照点

quote: still fall below a simple hyperparameter search under the same time budget
notes: ⚠️ 最强反例：agent 打赢默认配置，但**打不过**同等预算的简单超参搜索

quote: Agents converge too quickly
notes: agent 行为分析：过快收敛到同一套服务栈

quote: Optimization pressure induces reward hacking
notes: 优化压力会诱发 reward hacking。这是「判据一旦可优化就会被钻」的实例

quote: strawman baselines manufacture speedups
notes: 失败模式一：稻草人基线制造加速比。⚠️ 这一条直接适用于评估所有「加速 N 倍」的声明

quote: absolute times do not transfer across machines
notes: 失败模式二：绝对耗时不可跨机器迁移。即「3x」必须绑定硬件才有意义

quote: infrastructure defects impersonate science
notes: 失败模式四：基础设施缺陷冒充科学结论。这一条最难自查
同一批模型在更严协议下几何平均只有 0.88x，即打不过 PyTorch 基线

quote: is defined by its data, model, replica, and sequence parallelism dimensions
notes: ASAP 的对象是分片配置（四个并行维度的组合），不是代码。⚠️ 该句全貌含带空格的括号与弯引号，故只引可核对的尾段

quote: limited by its dependence on accurate profiling data
notes: ⚠️ ASAP 自陈：依赖准确的 profiling 数据、且只有一个全局分片配置。且明确说「未来要加 Evaluator Agent 才形成闭环」——它现在是**开环**
CANNBot-CAKE 在 Ascend 950PR 上标准集 1060/1060 全过
平均 1.334x over baseline

quote: no shortage of tests, logs, profiling tools, or microbenchmarks
notes: 工具不缺，缺的是把观察**组织成 agent 可直接执行的流程**
